# Food data licence attribution

OmniGart food logging uses two nutrient data sources. Ship this notice in About / Data attribution screens and with any redistributed offline packs.

## USDA FoodData Central

United States Department of Agriculture **FoodData Central** datasets used by OmniGart (Foundation Foods, SR Legacy, FNDDS) are **United States government works** and are generally in the **public domain**.

- Site: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/
- OmniGart may ship a compressed SQLite subset or offer an optional download. Code that loads the pack is AGPL-3.0 (OmniGart); the USDA data itself remains public domain.

Suggested notice:

> Nutrient data includes information from USDA FoodData Central (public domain).  
> https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/

## Open Food Facts (ODbL)

Branded products and barcodes may use **Open Food Facts** data, © Open Food Facts contributors, available under the **Open Database Licence (ODbL)**.

- Site: https://world.openfoodfacts.org/
- Licence: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/
- Database contents may also be under DbCL 1.0 and/or copyright of producers.

You must:

1. Attribute Open Food Facts.
2. Share-alike any public database derived from OFF under ODbL.
3. Keep notices with redistributed dumps / packs.

Suggested notice (also in `shared/nutrition-data/ATTRIBUTION.md`):

> Data from Open Food Facts — https://world.openfoodfacts.org/  
> Made available under the Open Database Licence:  
> https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/  
> Contents may also be available under DbCL 1.0.

## Not used

OmniGart does **not** use NCCDB or other proprietary nutrient databases that would conflict with these terms.
